claims.claim: The mean adds values and divides by their count. The median is the middle ordered value (or mean of the two middle values). Range is maximum minus minimum; standard deviation describes dispersion around the mean. Measures answer different questions. The mean can be influenced by extreme values; the median is less sensitive to their magnitude. Always state units and sample definition. A single summary can conceal skew, clusters or unusual cases.

locators.limitations: Choice of measure depends on context
